source.highlight: Scientists think they've found ancient remnants of dinosaur blood
source.after: Scientists have studied plenty of dinosaur bones, eggs and footprints. Now, some think they've found their strongest evidence yet of dinosaur blood.

source.highlight: Mice can learn to fight by watching tiny rodent cage matches, study finds
source.after: Brain scientists set up "gladiator style" cage matches for mice — and found that simply observing fighting matches can rewire a mouse's brain to resemble those who actually fought.
